headline: GTA 6 countdown: 8 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 8 Days Left | Leonida | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 8 days until GTA 6. The whole game is set in Leonida, a fictional US state based on Florida. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Leonida: sunshine, swamps, and probably a lot of alligators.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 8 days to go. The whole game is set in Leonida, a fictional US state based on Florida. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
